units: local/flat MSE in native plane squared units; shape response errors and ratios dimensionless
rules: No new reconstruction or fit. Oracle-local selects minimum true local MSE per state; oracle-flat selects minimum true uniform-control MSE. Both are oracle diagnostics, not blind policies. Ties follow MODELS order. Pareto axes: flat MSE,local MSE,response shape distortion; all minimized. Equal-state ratio summaries, not independent samples or ratio of pooled energies. No blend/covariance inference from scalar errors.
limitations: Same reused heldout pairs and known synthetic truth; data already used for model exploration, not independent final validation. Oracle selection not deployable, no causal estimate of an observable selector. Source hashes retained, source pixels not copied. No change to production.
